summary: Milestone 2026.05.233 produced 0 experiments in the timing window — the twelfth consecutive empty-experiment milestone. The milestone was consumed by planning work: diagnosing the catastrophic Codex CLI failure that caused 11/14 .232 tasks to emit identical boilerplate non-responses, and drafting a 14-task roadmap (exp2392–exp2405) that puts Codex CLI diagnosis (exp2393) as the first activation gate. No compute-bound work executed and both GPUs remained idle at 0% utilization throughout.
bottlenecks_identified: Twelfth consecutive milestone with zero experiment commits in the timing window — the pre-test cascade and Codex CLI infrastructure failure are the structural root cause blocking all downstream tasks.

Codex CLI catastrophic failure (.232: 11/14 tasks emitted identical 'u finish the real work inside 10 minutes' boilerplate) was not diagnosed within the milestone that produced it; diagnosis was deferred to .233 planning, adding one full milestone of delay before any repair attempt.
AUROC gap of 0.1948 (current 0.685 vs HalluScan baseline 0.88) remains unchanged since before .230 — no compute progress while infrastructure is broken.
FR-11, FST PATH A/B, KV260, and Phase 1 ship gate remain unvalidated because all compute tasks have been blocked by infrastructure failures for 12+ milestones.
improvements_suggested: Activate exp2393 (Codex CLI Diagnostic, requires_claude:true) as the absolute first task of .234; do not activate any Codex experiment until exp2393 confirms the CLI is repaired.
Add a Codex CLI smoke-test as a mandatory pre-milestone activation gate: a trivial 5-line codex task that must succeed before the conductor activates the remaining 13 tasks.

If exp2393 confirms the Codex CLI is broken beyond repair in the current environment, immediately flip all 12 remaining codex tasks to agent_type:claude for .234 to break the empty-milestone chain — quota burn is preferable to another empty milestone.

Cap planning-only milestones at 1 consecutive occurrence; if two planning milestones fire back-to-back with 0 experiments, the conductor should auto-escalate to operator with a 'infrastructure_blocked' sentinel before drafting a third plan.

Both RTX 3090 GPUs are fully idle — DualGPURunner can load Qwen3.6-35B on GPU 0 and Gemma-4-31B on GPU 1 in parallel once compute tasks resume, recovering approximately 40-50% wall time on multi-model experiments.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Repair Codex CLI (exp2393): 12 consecutive empty milestones trace to infrastructure failure; fixing this single dependency unblocks all 12 deferred codex experiments simultaneously.

Enforce a pre-activation smoke-test gate in the conductor: a trivial codex task confirming CLI health must pass before any experiment is activated — prevents another 14-task plan from silently failing with boilerplate responses.

On confirmed Codex CLI repair, execute AUROC closure (exp2394 HALT Tier 0j + exp2395 FregeLogic + exp2398 HIVE ensemble) as the first compute block to close the 0.1948 AUROC gap that has been frozen for 12+ milestones.
meta_reflection: The meta-pattern is now unambiguous: 12 consecutive empty milestones means the infrastructure failure is the work, not the research experiments. Every planning cycle that produces another 14-task YAML without first confirming the executor is repaired is a guaranteed empty milestone. The .233 roadmap correctly makes exp2393 (Codex CLI diagnosis) the phase-0 gate — that structural discipline, applied one milestone earlier (.232 or .231), would have saved 2-3 planning cycles of wall time. Going forward, the highest-value process improvement is not better experiment design but ensuring the execution substrate is verified healthy before any research plan is committed.
